note: Spec-pinned fixtures for SOLANA-WITHHELD-FEE-RECON-1. Primary text re-pinned at claim per SOLANA-BUILD-CHAIN-COMMON-2026-10-27 section 2: solana-program/token-2022 at commit b5b7511e5d4f19a6a118b858d83a7fe3b0017b1e (2026-10-06) — interface/src/extension/transfer_fee/mod.rs L135-L151 (TransferFeeConfig.withheld_amount u64, withdraw_withheld_authority MaybeNull) and L178-L181 (TransferFeeAmount.withheld_amount u64), interface/src/extension/transfer_fee/instruction.rs L118-L135 (WithdrawWithheldTokensFromAccounts authority-signed, HarvestWithheldTokensToMint permissionless), program/src/extension/transfer_fee/processor.rs L169-L227 (harvest skips a wrong-mint account with MintMismatch and accumulates the mint pot with checked_add, TokenError::Overflow past u64). Hand-derived pins: F1/F2 clean reconciliations; F3/F4 declared-vs-recomputed divergence signs; F5 wrong-mint account excluded from the harvestable sum (MintMismatch skip) but flagged; F6 duplicate address counted as declared and flagged; F7/F8 the u64 boundary (exactly u64::MAX vs one past it: sums are computed in unbounded BigInt and reported, the on-chain checked_add would fail the harvest with Overflow); F9/F10 fee-receiver placement (destination mint and withdraw authority versus the config); F11 the empty-list floor; F12 the multi-flag vector pinning flag order; F13-F15 refusals. output_payload is filled by fill-fixture-payloads.mjs and golden_hash by golden-parity.test.mjs --update; spec_pins carry the hand-derived expected values and are asserted by the proptest, so the corpus is NOT a round-trip self-test.

vectors.name: F1_clean_match_no_destination
vectors.spec_ref: pinned processor.rs L195-L227: harvest sums every mint-matching account; declared total equals the recomputed sum

output_payload.note: Withheld amounts are per-account TransferFeeAmount.withheld_amount and the mint-level TransferFeeConfig.withheld_amount, both u64 in token minor units, pinned at solana-program/token-2022 commit b5b7511e5d4f19a6a118b858d83a7fe3b0017b1e. recomputed_account_sum counts only accounts whose mint matches the declared mint: the harvest instruction skips a wrong-mint account with MintMismatch instead of moving its fees. post_harvest_mint_withheld is what the mint would accumulate after harvesting every mint-matching account; the on-chain addition is checked_add, so an amount past u64 fails the harvest with TokenError::Overflow, reported here as post_harvest_would_overflow_u64. Mint and authority comparisons are string equality on the pasted values; this kernel reads nothing on-chain.
